parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotency of the request. You can generate a parameter value of up to 64 ASCII characters from the client and assign the value to ClientToken to ensure the idempotency of retry requests. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotency](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ContainerNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the Docker container. For more information about Docker container images, see [Container Registry](~~60744~~).

parameters.name: ContainerRepository
parameters.description: The Docker image repository. For more information about Docker container images, see [Container Registry](~~60744~~).

parameters.name: ContainerTag
parameters.description: The Docker image tag. For more information about Docker container images, see [Container Registry](~~60744~~).

parameters.name: DataDisk
parameters.description: The list of data cloud disk information.

sub_parameters.name: Index
sub_parameters.description:
The index of the data cloud disk on the destination Alibaba Cloud ECS instance. The initial value is 1. Valid values: 1 to 16.


>You can create destination data cloud disks only for data disks that exist on the migration source.

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description:
The size of the data cloud disk on the destination Alibaba Cloud ECS instance. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20 to 32768.
>The value of this parameter must be greater than the actual used space of the migration source data cloud disk. For example, if the source data cloud disk size is 500 GiB with 100 GiB actually used, the value of this parameter must be greater than 100 GiB.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the migration task.

The description must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: Disks
parameters.description: The disk information.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description:
The interval at which the incremental migration task runs. Unit: hours. Valid values: 1 to 168.

This parameter is required when RunOnce is set to false.

Default value: null.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description:
The name of the destination Alibaba Cloud image delivered by the migration task. The image name must meet the following requirements:

- The image name must be unique within the same Alibaba Cloud region.
- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

> During the migration task, if an image with the same name already exists in the current region, the system appends the migration task ID (JobId) as a suffix to the image name by default, such as ImageName_j-2zexxxxxxxxxxxxx.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The target instance ID.

parameters.name: InstanceRamRole
parameters.description: The name of the instance RAM role.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance type of the intermediate ECS instance.

Call [DescribeInstanceTypes](~~25620~~) to query the instance types provided by Elastic Compute Service (ECS).

- If you specify this parameter, the system creates the intermediate instance with the specified instance type. If the specified instance type is out of stock, the migration task fails to be created.
- If you do not specify this parameter, the system selects an instance type in a specific order to create the intermediate instance. For more information, see [What instance types can be used for intermediate instances in SMC FAQ](~~121707~~).

parameters.name: JobType
parameters.description: The type of the migration task. Valid values:

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance launch template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateVersion
parameters.description: The version of the instance launch template.

parameters.name: LicenseType
parameters.description:
The license type. Valid values:

- Empty value: no license.
- BYOL: Bring Your Own License.

For more information, see [SMC FAQ](~~121707~~).

parameters.name: MaxNumberOfImageToKeep
parameters.description:
The maximum number of images retained by default for an incremental migration task. Valid values: 1 to 10.

This parameter is required when RunOnce is set to false.

Default value: null.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the migration task. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The task name must be unique.
- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NetMode
parameters.description:
The network mode for data transmission. Valid values:

- 0: public network transmission mode. The migration source must have access to the Internet, and migration data is transmitted over the Internet.
- 2: internal network transmission mode. If you select this mode, you must set the VSwitchId parameter. You do not need to set the VpcId parameter because the service can automatically obtain the VPC ID through internal API calls.

Default value: 0.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination Alibaba Cloud region to which the migration source is to be migrated.

parameters.name: ReplicationParameters
parameters.description: The parameter information of the replication driver. The parameter information is in JSON key-value pair format with fixed keys. Maximum length: 2048 characters.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RunOnce
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to create a one-time migration task or an incremental migration task. Valid values:

- true (default): one-time migration task. The task runs only once after it is created.

- false: incremental migration task. After the task is created, it automatically runs on a periodic basis based on the value of the `Frequency` parameter. Incremental migration tasks allow you to synchronize incremental data from the migration source to Alibaba Cloud without pausing your business, and generate a full-data image of the migration source at the time the task runs.

> This parameter can be specified only when you create a migration task. After the value is specified, it cannot be changed.

parameters.name: ScheduledStartTime
parameters.description:
The execution time of the migration task. The value of this parameter must meet the following requirements:

- The time must follow the ISO 8601 standard in UTC+0. The format is YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. For example, 2018-01-01T12:00:00Z indicates 20:00:00 on January 1, 2018 (UTC+8).
- The value must be later than the current time and within 30 days from the current time.

>If this parameter is left empty, Server Migration Center (SMC) does not start the migration task. You must call [StartReplicationJob](~~121823~~) to start the task.

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the migration source.

parameters.name: SystemDiskPart
parameters.description: The partition information of the system cloud disk.

sub_parameters.name: Block
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable block replication for system cloud disk partition N. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Device
sub_parameters.description:
The device identifier of system disk partition N. For the actual value of N, refer to the partition device identifier of the migration source.
> If `SystemDiskPart.N.SizeBytes` is not empty, this parameter cannot be empty either.

sub_parameters.name: SizeBytes
sub_parameters.description: The size of system cloud disk partition N. Unit: bytes. Default value: the size of the source system cloud disk partition.

parameters.name: SystemDiskSize
parameters.description:
The system cloud disk size of the destination Alibaba Cloud ECS instance. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20 to 2048.

> The value of this parameter must be greater than the actual used space of the migration source system cloud disk. For example, if the source system cloud disk size is 500 GiB but the actual used space is 100 GiB, the value of this parameter must be greater than 100 GiB.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the migration task. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the migration task. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The target type of the migration task. Valid values:
- Image: After a successful migration, Server Migration Center (SMC) generates an Alibaba Cloud image for your migration source.
- ContainerImage: After a successful migration, SMC generates a Docker container image for your migration source.
- TargetInstance: After a successful migration, SMC migrates your migration source directly to the target instance. If you set this parameter to TargetInstance, you must also specify the InstanceId parameter.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch in the specified VPC.

parameters.name: ValidTime
parameters.description: The expiration time of the migration task. Valid values: creation time of the migration task + 7 days to creation time of the migration task + 90 days.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC for which Express Connect or VPN Gateway is configured.
